verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an Audiences feature (build audiences on warehouse sources and activate them), so the axis applies. Its natural-language capabilities (the MCP server and the Rudder AI Slack agent) are documented only for debugging delivery errors, monitoring pipelines, writing transformations, reviewing tracking plans and audit logs, not for turning a natural-language audience description into a reviewable, schema-grounded segment definition. The homepage line about AI chat interfaces helping teams 'segment' data is vague marketing and does not establish this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can describe an audience in natural language and AI builds the segment definition for review, grounded in my actual schema
